data.name: POK
data.detailed_description:
Step into the arena where the sun and moon were born.

POK is a 3D arcade sports game that blends competitive gameplay with fighting mechanics, inspired by the ancient Mesoamerican ball game, Pok-Ta-Pok.

Compete in 1v1 and up to 4v4 matches where precision, positioning, and teamwork define victory. Every hit matters.

[Insert gameplay GIF or highlight clip here]

Fast, skill-based gameplay

Master three core strikes—hip, forearm, and knee—each with its own timing and strategy. Use walls, angles, and momentum to outplay your opponents. Every movement creates opportunity.

[Insert GIF showing core mechanics / hits / rebounds]

Simple to learn, hard to master

Accessible controls meet deep mechanics. Whether you're landing your first hit or pulling off advanced plays, every match feels dynamic and rewarding.

[Insert GIF showing beginner vs advanced play contrast]

Dynamic arenas

Play in stylized courts inspired by Mesoamerican architecture. Each arena introduces unique angles and opportunities for creative plays, encouraging players to experiment and adapt.

[Insert arena showcase images or GIF]

Team-based competition

Coordinate with your teammate in 2v2 matches to control the pace of the game, set up plays, and secure victory through communication and strategy.

[Insert 2v2 gameplay GIF or coordinated play moment]

A world inspired by the Popol Vuh

Experience a narrative rooted in Mayan mythology, reimagined through a modern lens.

Follow Huna and Ixe as they uncover the mystery behind a world falling into imbalance, where the fate of their people is tied to the ancient game.

[Insert cinematic or narrative scene images]

Chapter-based experience

Chapter 1 launches with a complete gameplay experience and story introduction. Future chapters will expand the world, characters, and challenges.

Roadmap:

  • September 15th 2026 Demo Launch

  • March 15th 2027 Chapter 1 Launch

Planned features: 

  • Online multiplayer

  • Ranked and competitive modes

  • New arenas and abilities

  • Expanded story chapters

Wishlist POK and be part of a new legend in the making.
